title: A2UI canvas
description: CopilotKit's standard components that the canvas demo uses.

Box.description: A flex container. It stacks its children in a column (direction "row" puts them in a row). Use it to group children with gap, padding, border, radius or background.

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Column.description: A vertical flex container. Its default gap already separates sections, so do not add padding, background or a Spacer for space.

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Row.description: A horizontal flex container. Label and value pair: justify "spaceBetween", a Caption left and a Text with fontWeight "medium" right. Buttons go in a Row at the bottom of a Card: one variant "primary", the others default or "borderless".

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Grid.description: A CSS grid container. On a narrow screen, its columns collapse towards one column.

columns.description: Column count or CSS template. Default 2

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

GridItem.description: A cell of a Grid, with an optional span. A span that covers all rendered columns fills the row.

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Card.description: A bordered panel, only for an interactive panel (controls, a form, a configurator); tables, charts and text need none. Give it a Title and a Caption. Separate groups with a Divider or the gap, never a nested Card or bordered Box. Variant "section": no box; "outline": always a box. In markdown mode, without controls it renders as "section" unless variant or border is set.

onVisible.description: Sent once, the first time the container scrolls into view. Use it to load more content lazily.

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

shadowStyle.description: Overrides the shadow of the variant

Spacer.description: Flexible empty space. You almost never need it: use the default gap.

Divider.description: A line between two groups: horizontal, or vertical with axis "vertical" in a Row.

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Title.description: A heading in a Card or next to another component; a heading alone is markdown. Size "2xl" at most once per surface, "lg" for sections. "sm" is an h4, "md"/"lg" an h3 (default "md"), "xl" and up an h2. Bold unless strong is false.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Text.description: Body text in a Card or next to another component; a paragraph alone is markdown outside the fence. Color "default" or "secondary". `text` takes inline markdown (**bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, ++underline++, `code`, [link](url)). `children` ids render inline after it, e.g. a Badge.

text.description: Text with inline markdown. A bound number shows as text

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

fontSize.description: Pixels when a number. Wins over size

minLines.description: Reserves the height of this many lines

Caption.description: Small secondary text: a hint under a control, or a label in a Row. `text` can have inline markdown.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Label.description: The label of a form field.

color.description: One of default|prose|primary|emphasis|secondary|tertiary|success|info|warning|caution|danger|discovery or a CSS color

Badge.description: A small status pill. Use the colors success, danger and warning only to show a status, not for decoration.

Button.description: Sends its onClick event; with href it opens the URL, with copy it copies the text. Variant "primary" for the one main Button in a Row. submit true submits the Form around it. Its children render instead of the label. With checks it is disabled while a check fails.

onClick.description: Sent when the user clicks the button.

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

text.description: Same as label. Used when label is not set

variant.description: Default "default": outlined. "primary" is filled, for the one main action. "borderless" has no box, like a link

submit.description: Submits the Form around it. The Form sends its onSubmit event

uniform.description: A square button, for an icon

href.description: Opens this URL in a new tab on click, instead of onClick

copy.description: Copies this text to the clipboard on click and shows a check mark, instead of onClick

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Form.description: A layout container that is a form. It sends onSubmit when the user submits (a Button with submit true, or Enter in a field). Put its field values in the event context with { "@path": "/x" }.

onSubmit.description: Sent when the user submits the form.

label.description: A short name of the form for screen readers

background.description: Leave it unset. A surface token such as surface, surface-secondary, info, success, warning, danger, discovery, or one with -solid, or a CSS color. Only one summary panel in a Card uses "surface-secondary"

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

TextField.description: A text input, single-line unless variant is "longText". Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user typed. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

value.description: Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user typed

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

variant.description: Default "shortText". "longText" is a multi-line field, "obscured" a password

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

TextArea.description: A multi-line text input. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user typed. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

value.description: Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user entered

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Select.description: A dropdown list of options. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read the chosen option. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

value.description: Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read what the user entered

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

clearLabel.description: The label of the empty option

icon.description: Lucide icon shown before the value

CheckBox.description: A checkbox with a label. Bind value with { "@path": "/x" } to read its state, true or false.

label.description: The label text. Always set it

value.description: True when checked. Bind it with { "@path": "/x" } to read the state of the box

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

lineThrough.description: Default false. Strikes the label when the box is checked

DateTimeInput.description: A date picker, a time picker with enableTime, or both. timeStep (minutes) offers fixed times, e.g. 30 for a booking. The value is ISO 8601. Give it a label.

label.description: The visible label of the field. Always set it

checks.description: Validation rules. The control shows the first failed one

condition.description: A validator call, for example {"@call":"required","args":{"value":{"@path":"/x"}}}, or a boolean binding

message.description: Shown when the check fails, instead of the default message

enableDate.description: The user picks a date. Default true unless only enableTime is set

timeStep.description: Minutes between the times the user can pick, e.g. 15 or 30. Shows the time as a list

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

Table.description: A data table, in a plain Column, not a Card. Give "columns" and "rows", or "children": TableSection or TableRow ids, or a template { "componentId", "path" } repeating a TableRow per item. A component in a cell or header (Badge, Button, Icon, Text): { "componentId": "<id>" }, with the id in "cellComponents".

rows.description: A list of row lists. A cell is a string, a number, or { "componentId": "<id>" } to show a component. Default []

caption.description: A short name of the table for screen readers. It is not shown

Chart.description: A bar, line, area, scatter, pie or donut chart. "data" is a list of objects. "xKey" is the field of the category. "series" are the value fields.

xKey.description: The field of the category axis

series.description: Default: every number field except xKey

color.description: A text color token or a CSS color

layout.description: "horizontal" draws the bars from left to right. Default "vertical"

yAxis.description: Example: {label: "Revenue (USD)", min: 0, max: 100}. In a horizontal chart it is the horizontal axis, and width sets the category axis width

showDots.description: Point markers on a line or area

barRadius.description: The corner radius of a bar, in pixels

showLabelLines.description: Leader lines of the slice labels. Default true

format.description: With "percent", data values and axis min/max are fractions: 0.4 shows as 40%; for 0% to 10%, use min: 0 and max: 0.1.

Icon.description: A Lucide icon by kebab-case name (for example "arrow-right"), or an A2UI icon name (for example "arrowBack"). Set label when no text next to the icon says what it means.

name.description: A Lucide icon name in kebab-case ("arrow-right"), an A2UI icon name ("arrowBack"), or { "svgPath" } on a 24px grid

label.description: What the icon means, for screen readers. Leave it unset when text next to the icon says the same

weight.description: flex-grow in a Row or Column

required.description: Valid when the value is not empty

regex.description: Valid when the value matches the pattern

length.description: Valid when the length of the value is within min and max

numeric.description: Valid when the value is a number within min and max

email.description: Valid when the value is an email address

formatString.description: Interpolates ${/path}, ${relative/path} and ${fn(arg: value)} in the value; \${ is a literal

formatNumber.description: The number in the locale of the user

formatCurrency.description: The amount as money, with an ISO 4217 currency code

formatDate.description: A date or ISO string in a TR35 pattern, for example "MMM d, yyyy" or "HH:mm"

pluralize.description: The string of the plural category of the value

openUrl.description: Opens an http(s) URL in a new tab. Only from an event

and.description: True when every value is true

or.description: True when any value is true

calc.description: The value of an arithmetic expression over the other args, by name: + - * / % ( ), x ^ y (power), comparisons, && || !, cond ? a : b, min max round floor ceil abs pow sqrt exp ln log10, the constants pi and e, 'text' + name

series.description: A list of count copies of item, for chart data and template lists. Put arithmetic in ${expression} strings in item, using the loop variable (default i, counting from start, default 1) and other named args. A whole-expression string retains the result type, so "${i * monthlyCost}" yields a number. Arguments, including nested calc or formatString calls in item, resolve before the series loop; those calls cannot use the loop variable. Example: {"@call":"series","args":{"count":6,"item":{"month":"${i}","cost":"${i * monthlyCost}"},"monthlyCost":{"@path":"/monthlyCost"}}}. Omit variable to use i.
